brief:
Israel advanced plans for 627 new settler housing units in the occupied West Bank, Al Jazeera English reported. The tender represents a significant expansion of Israeli settlement construction in the territory and follows years of accelerated building in occupied Palestinian land.

Palestinian officials warned that the new settlement project aims to deepen Israeli control over West Bank territory and sever Palestinian connections to Jerusalem. They characterized the tender as part of a broader strategy to entrench Israeli presence across the occupied territory. The announcement underscores the ongoing dispute over settlements, which the international community largely considers illegal under international law, though Israel contests this position.
dek: New settlement tender in West Bank deepens Israeli efforts to sever Palestinian ties to Jerusalem, officials warn.
title: Israel advances plan for 627 new settler units in West Bank
